classSemantics

packages/sql-semantics/src/Facade/Semantics.php:55
final class Semantics
Public API: explicitly declared with @visibility public.

Analyzes SQL of one fixed language profile into read-only operations.

An operation holds the concrete structure of the statement, the facts derived against an explicit declaration context, and SQL rendered from that structure. Nothing here changes an operation: a different statement is analyzed anew or built from explicit inputs.

Methods§

public function __construct(
    Dialect $dialect,
    string|null $grammarVersion = null,
    Mode|null $mode = null,
    ParameterStyle $parameters = ParameterStyle::Native,
    SearchPath|null $searchPath = null,
)
source§

Fixes the language profile: database, grammar release, session mode and parameter style.

Parameters

$dialectDialectThe database
$grammarVersionstring|nullA release tag the database package ships, or null for its default
$modeMode|nullThe session settings SQL is read under, or null for the defaults of the database
$parametersParameterStyleWhich parameter markers are read; the named style adds `:name`
$searchPathSearchPath|nullThe schemas an unqualified relation name is searched in, or null for the default of the database

Throws

InvalidArgumentException When the release, mode or search path does not belong to the database

public function parser(): SqlParser
source§

Answers the parser of the language profile.

A caller that parses SQL itself, to read the syntax tree before the analysis or to report a syntax error as the database does, parses with this parser and passes the tree to analyze().

public function context(
    list<Table|Operation>|null $declarations = null,
    bool $complete = true,
    SearchPath|null $searchPath = null,
    Session|null $session = null,
): AnalysisContext
source§

Creates an immutable declaration context.

Null declarations give an open context: relations that are not declared may exist. A list, even an empty one, gives a context that enumerates every relation unless $complete is false. An operation in the list contributes the declarations it provides; it is not executed, and ALTER, DROP and writes contribute nothing.

Parameters

$declarationslist<Table|Operation>|nullThe declarations, or null for an open context without any
$completeboolWhether a given list enumerates every relation
$searchPathSearchPath|nullThe schemas an unqualified relation name is searched in, or null for the path fixed at construction
$sessionSession|nullThe session statements are resolved in, or null for a new session with the server defaults

Returns

AnalysisContext

Throws

InvalidConstruction When a declaration belongs to another language profile
InvalidArgumentException When the search path does not belong to the database

public function analyze(
    string|Node $sql,
    list<Table|Operation>|AnalysisContext|null $context = null,
): Operation
source§

Analyzes one input into an operation against an explicit declaration context.

The input is SQL text, or the syntax tree of one input that the parser of this profile (parser()) produced; a tree of another parser is read as if this profile had produced it.

Semantic problems of grammatical SQL, such as a missing column, are facts of the returned operation. The operation is returned only after its structure was confirmed to hold every operand of the input and its rendered SQL was confirmed to carry the same significant tokens.

Parameters

$sqlstring|NodeThe SQL text, or the tree parser() produced for it
$contextlist<Table|Operation>|AnalysisContext|nullThe declarations, a prepared context, or null for an open context

Returns

Operation

Throws

AnalysisException When the SQL is outside the selected grammar
InvalidConstruction When the context belongs to another language profile

    list<Table|Operation>|AnalysisContext|null $context = null,
): list<Operation>
source§

Analyzes each statement of a script against the same explicit declaration context.

No statement is executed for the ones after it.

Parameters

$sqlstring
$contextlist<Table|Operation>|AnalysisContext|nullThe declarations, a prepared context, or null for an open context

list<Operation>

public function split(string $sql): list<string>
source§

Finds the statement boundaries of a script, as the database finds them.

Each text ends with its own terminator; trailing whitespace and comments stay with the last statement. A semicolon inside a string, a comment, or a compound statement ends nothing.

Parameters

$sqlstring

Returns

list<string>
